audience: developers who check Supabase projects, advisors and read-only data access

useCases.title: Find unhealthy projects
useCases.text: List the projects of the account, then check the health of their auth, database, storage and realtime services.

useCases.title: Review security and performance advisors
useCases.text: Read the security findings, such as tables without row level security. Read the performance findings, such as unindexed foreign keys.

useCases.title: Run a read-only query to check data
useCases.text: Run one SQL query as the read-only database role, to inspect data or count rows. Writes and schema changes are rejected by the database.

useCases.title: Generate TypeScript types for a schema
useCases.text: Generate TypeScript types for the database schemas of a project, by default the public schema. Use them in the app code.

useCases.title: Manage Edge Function secrets
useCases.text: List the names and update times of the secrets. Set or delete secrets by name. Secret values are never returned.

useCases.title: Inspect Edge Functions
useCases.text: List the Edge Functions deployed to a project, with status, version and JWT setting. Read one function's metadata. The source is not returned.
